verdict.rationale: INPI runs a machine-facing data channel (the data.inpi.fr open-data portal, which requires an account-issued token), so asking whether it offers a public sandbox or test environment is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence documents one: the docs cover filing procedures and general services, and the probe shows only the production portal returning 403 to keyless requests.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
